svg.title: IPAWCUS Data Flow — FigJam Board
svg.desc: Combined context and Level 1 data-flow diagrams, arranged as two FigJam-ready frames.

text.tspan: Import this SVG into FigJam, then ungroup it to edit individual vector elements.
Process 0 and the four external user roles — centered snowflake layout
External role → Process 0 → External role response
Rectangle = external entity Oval = Process 0 Arrow label = data crossing the system boundary

visit, stock, billing and payment status

Access, pet, booking, payment and queue
Right-to-left layout: external roles feed system processes, which validate and persist data in logical stores
LOGICAL DATA STORES ← SYSTEM PROCESSES ← EXTERNAL ROLES
Rectangle = external entity Rounded box = process Open-ended box = logical data store Arrow label = data moved
